review_scope: Read-only actual v11 cached parentHTML and Casimir AJAX component; independent of A triage. No new network, repository edits or membership approvals.
semantic_conclusion: The observed expanded biography is a component of one human-visible subject notice but a separate HTTP response. Defensible attribution requires the linked-source bundle; it cannot satisfy the literal same-HTTP-body flag.

cths_notice_component_bundle_verified.meaning: Explicit new component branch, never blanket CTHS acceptance.

cths_same_body_authorship_role_start_ver.meaning: Legacy single-response gate cannot be asserted across parent and AJAX responses.

cths_parent_notice_url.meaning: Captured original person page, exact selected savant ID.

cths_parent_notice_sha256.meaning: Recomputed from actual retained parent response bytes.

cths_observed_expansion_handler.meaning: Literal actual parent handler, parsed without eval; q=proso_bio_detail, exact selected ID, dep=y, target proso_bio_detail.

cths_expanded_biography_url.meaning: Must equal URL resolved from observed handler and actual parent routing JS.

cths_expanded_biography_sha256.meaning: Actual separately retained response bytes, not a snippet or SHA-only inherited claim.

cths_expansion_preview_career_continuity.meaning: Parent preview and expanded content agree for same subject; HTML entity and whitespace normalization only. Expected matching close-handler ID is checked when returned.

cths_subject_identity_career_verified.meaning: Parent title/DOB plus observed exact-ID route, response continuity and subject career; do not claim DOB/name appears inside fragment if absent.

cths_typed_ordinary_role_verified.meaning: Existing ordinary/free/nonresident member-class requirement, with exact subject/institution locator in bundle component.

cths_literal_full_member_start_verified.meaning: Direct literal ordinary-family event/start, or root-approved unambiguous single full-member interval; no calculated, relative or as-of event.

cths_notice_authorship_credit_component.meaning: Institutional notice credit occurs on retained parent response; never invent an AJAX author byline.

credited_authors.type: array of exact bounded comma-list tokens
credited_authors.meaning: From Rédacteur(s) de la notice before Fiche créée/copyright, not meta-author, picture, reference or affiliation.

source_author_credit.meaning: Exact credited institution; parent-only never relabelled Academy writer.

academy_authored_or_issued_original.meaning: True only when exact Académie des sciences token is a credited writer on parent.

parent_institution_authored_or_issued_or.meaning: True only when exact Institut de France token is a credited writer on parent.

source_independence_group.meaning: One logical person-notice authorial contribution; parent and AJAX are not counted as independent sources.

source_capture_components.meaning: Both original response URL/SHA/status/time/bytes and claim locators retained. If legacy singular source_url/SHA remain, explicitly identify the anchor component; do not omit second hash.

approval_checks: Parent original bytes exist, are read and rehashed; source title/name/DOB/career match preserved selected identity. Any new body DOB difference is an unapplied lead for root and prevents silent triple promotion.
Parent notice writer block is isolated before Fiche créée/copyright. Exact comma-list institutional token is required; individual writers or affiliations alone do not qualify.

Observe the expansion click inside the subject proso_bio_detail element. Parse literal parameters without eval or ID substitution. Resolve the endpoint using actual cached ajax_data routing JS and the parent URL.

Require exact ID consistency among selected record, parentURL, handler query and any returned closing handler/identifier. No generic endpoint guessing for a person lacking an observed expansion handler.
Retain the actual200 expanded response separately with URL/time/bytes/SHA; reject error/challenge/redirect-to-another-person responses. No replayed SHA without raw bytes.
Read subject content after excluding script/style/helper code and collapse UI. Check preview/career continuity and expected closing target/ID. A shared JavaScript helper is not identity evidence.

Notice-level institutional writer attribution may scope the observed biography component only within this linked person-notice bundle. The fragment has no standalone author credit and is not literally the parent HTTP body.
Use the new component gate: cths_notice_component_bundle_verified=True, cths_evidence_spans_multiple_http_responses=True, legacy cths_same_body_authorship_role_start_verified=False.

Apply existing ordinary/free/nonresident class and direct-start gates unchanged. Keep exact Paris science institution separate from medicine, local academies, other societies and quoted third-party biographies.

If role and start are in different components, attach individual component hashes/locators and demonstrate the event refers to the subject and same full-member phase. An unseparated correspondent/foreign/full interval cannot supply its earliest year.

Preserve all known foreign/correspondent and election/DOB conflicts. Generic membre or a richer biography cannot override explicit contrary role controls. No nationality classification, source majority, lifetime exclusion, presidency/as-of or relative arithmetic.

Record both retrieval times; do not assert an identical server version. Material author/identity/preview/date/class discontinuity is held for review; cached-parent plus fresh-fragment is disclosed, not silently called a contemporaneous same-response original.

Independent QA rehashes and reads both actual originals for every positive and binds final decision and manifest hashes. Combined source quotations stay within25words per notice; raw bodies remain private.
